content.text: Section 24 fully satisfies the preferred position; no conflicting provisions elsewhere.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position in full. Clause 24.1 gives us a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, reorganization, acquisition or substantially-all-assets sale (notice only). Clause 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, and transfer by change of control to Customer's prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. Clause 24.3 applies a reasonable consent standard to other assignments, and clause 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, with cooperation on successor administrative changes. Section 13 (p0056) is consistent, allowing transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment. No walk-away features are present, so no redline is warranted.
